idea-plugin.name: Grok Build By Kafei
idea-plugin.description:
Grok Build is an IntelliJ chat for the xAI Grok agent. It uses the same WebView UI and ACP grok agent stdio core as the VS Code extension, hosted with JCEF and a Node sidecar. Requires Node.js and the Grok CLI.

IntelliJ 版 Grok Build：与 VS Code 插件共用同一套 WebView UI 和 Agent 核心。

  • Chat, login, API key, models, effort, Ask / Plan / Default modes
  • Grok Diff review and revert
  • Sessions, compact, rewind, fork, export, usage
  • Rules, skills, MCP, agents, worktrees, memory, marketplace
  • Add editor selection or the active file as context
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Grok Build By Kafei 0.2.0: compatibility range 2025.2–2026.3 (since-build 252, until-build 263.*).

0.2.0 — Louder notification chime. Wallpaper preview, video wallpaper, and turn-complete sounds.

0.1.114 — Wallpaper preview restores pan and zoom as soon as it opens, without nudging the slider.

0.1.113 — Notification chime is louder.

0.1.112 — Optional chime when a turn finishes or is interrupted.

0.1.111 — IDEA wallpaper videos: stage next to the chat page; transcode H.264 to WebM when ffmpeg is installed.

0.1.110 — Wallpaper zoom goes to 800% and always keeps the original aspect ratio.

0.1.109 — Wallpaper accepts looping videos (mp4, webm) and the full-window preview pans and centers them.

0.1.108 — Wallpaper preview is a full-window editor: click to set the center, drag to pan, at the current viewport size.

0.1.107 — Settings, history, and dashboard drawers actually frost-blur the home/chat behind them.

0.1.106 — One frost plate on home/chat; settings and drawers blur that main page. Less backdrop-filter jank.

0.1.105 — Keep wallpaper mounted when restoring a session; glass blur is adjustable.

0.1.104 — Home uses the same floating sheet as chat; more-menu stacks above the composer; glass opacity is adjustable.

0.1.103 — Theme panel style: frosted glass or a solid floating sheet; wallpaper can be panned and zoomed.

0.1.102 — Theme wallpaper: Grok icon or a custom image, with opacity, background color in the gaps, and center-crop when the image is larger than the chat.

0.1.101 — Drag workspace files onto the chat to attach them as references.

0.1.100 — Custom endpoints accept a max context window, including 128k-style values.

0.1.99 — Confirming an edited user message actually resends it (editUserPrompt was dropped by the host).

0.1.98 — Do not freeze the IDE on first open: show the tool window first, start Chromium on the next frame, and do not pre-warm a second Diff browser.

0.1.97 — Plugin Verifier: drop internal PluginManagerCore, deprecated ReadAction.compute, and override-only ActionGroup.getChildren.

0.1.96 — Pre-warm the Grok Diff browser so the first Review is a tab switch, not a JCEF cold start.

0.1.95 — Review clicks hop off the JCEF thread onto the EDT so Grok Diff can open.

0.1.94 — Grok Diff opens as a center editor tab; open-buffer reads/writes go through IntelliJ documents.

0.1.93 — Stop re-serializing the active file on every keystroke; coalesce JCEF stream paints.

0.1.92 — IntelliJ 2026.2: optional Web Browser (JCEF) dependency so the chat tool window can load.

0.1.89 — Marketplace Plugin Verifier: claim only the IntelliJ builds this binary is compiled against.

0.1.88 — Cancelled and leftover steps stay on the card and render muted instead of as errors.

0.1.87 — Full host rewrite: every VS Code command, live editor context, IntelliJ theme, status bar, settings, Grok Diff, terminal.
